status: reviewed seed glossary for adoption and endpoint-level completion

terms.definition: One HTTP method and route handled by the web application. It has its own request, response and authorization contract.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The generated machine-readable description of the HTTP surface of a particular build and configuration.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The interactive documentation frontend displaying the generated OpenAPI document. It does not generate this product's contract.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A serialized request or response shape exposed over a transport, including internal C# types reachable from endpoints.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: An owner-managed representation of business facts and rules; its shape is not automatically an HTTP contract.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A representation derived from authoritative owner data for a particular reader or purpose. It is not an alternative writer.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A JSON member whose presence the applicable transport contract requires. Presence and acceptance of null are separate decisions.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A member whose contract permits a JSON null value. This does not imply the member may be omitted.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A JSON member that is absent. Its effect is defined by the particular reader, default, update semantics and validation.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: An operation submitting the complete intended collection for the named owner/target. Omitted existing rows may be removed under the owner contract.
terms.documentation_rule: Describe empty-list behavior after verifying the owner; never describe a replacement as an incremental update.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: An integer position in a page-based collection. The inspected CRM query defaults to page index zero.
terms.documentation_rule: Specify the origin per endpoint; do not globalize the CRM default.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A continuation value returned by a cursor-paged API. Send it back through the matching continuation contract rather than treating it as a page number.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The endpoint-specific serialized container for failure information. This product has more than one envelope.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A diagnostic/run-correlation reference, not evidence that a mutation was committed and not automatically an idempotency key.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: HTTP authentication and endpoint policy enforcement when configured. It is not an agent capability grant.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A permission category tested by an authorization policy. State the concrete policy and accepted scopes for the operation.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A filter selecting which categories of records a query may return; it is not an access grant.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The organization/project or other admitted workspace context under which an operation resolves data and files.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The owner-provided evidence binding a write to the project lifetime that the caller read. The HTTP task update requires the returned admission even though its C# property is nullable.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A particular incarnation of a project used to fence stale writes and projections; equality of the public project identifier alone is insufficient.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A coordination claim under a defined scope/key and validity period. Do not present it as a substitute for authorization or lifetime admission.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: An owner-returned value representing the state a later mutation expects. Preserve its exact representation and obtain a fresh value by reading the owner.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A version in a specified owner stream. Qualify it as definition, transcript, assignment or publication revision; these are not interchangeable.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A business-supplied reference on a party. The inspected persistence mapping indexes it without declaring it unique.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The Projects-owned business container and lifecycle record to which project structure and participation are attached.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The Workbench-owned hierarchy and related task, node, link and asset operations within a project.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: An opaque structure-node key returned by the owner. It is not universally a GUID.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A task governed by the typed task application boundary, not an arbitrary WorkItem created through a generic node mutation.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The string node identifier of the canonical task. In task-update HTTP requests the body and route identifiers must match exactly.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The previously read task values used as preconditions for an edit; not guesses and not copies of the desired new values.
not_synonyms: latest state silently substituted at save time
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The caller's intended new task values, checked against current owner state and domain rules.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: Previously read task progress. The inspected validator accepts the untracked sentinel -1 or a tracked value from 0 through 100.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: Requested tracked progress, accepted only from 0 through 100 by the task-details validator.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The current or proposed explicit execution state and related actual timestamps; it is separate from displayed progress and planned schedule.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A typed schedule edit identifying affected tasks and their previous/proposed intervals, with a gesture and optional critical-task information.
not_synonyms: only the edited task always moves
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The start and end timestamps of a planned task interval. Preserve offsets/UTC semantics and owner constraints; do not silently convert to date-only values.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: Effort stored in hours, even when the chosen input/display unit is ManDays. Conversion belongs to the effort policy.
not_synonyms: raw value in the selected unit
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The chosen Hours or ManDays input/display unit. It does not change the stored unit of ExpectedEffortHours.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The conversion factor used by the effort policy; its default is eight, and overloads accept an explicit positive factor.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A nonnegative estimated amount with its associated currency, distinct from historical charges and recognized sales.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The owner-returned basis for an expected task cost, used with the edit precondition. The member can be null but CurrentCostBasis must be present in this JSON input.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The nonnegative owner revision for a task's direct assignments, submitted unchanged as an edit precondition.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A person or agent selected through the typed task-assignment path. This update does not accept process/workflow selections as direct assignees.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A typed execution/resource selection for a task. The separate resource-attachment endpoint can handle cases beyond direct person/agent assignment.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: CRM/HR-owned involvement and staffing facts in a project, distinct from Workbench-owned task assignments.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A Project Structure content record/placement whose metadata and actual bytes are retrieved through distinct supported operations.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A read through the authoritative current Project Structure service; the explicit HTTP read source.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A bounded snapshot attached to an eligible in-process agent invocation; unavailable as an HTTP read source and never silently replaced by canonical data.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A CRM/HR business identity used by roles, contacts, relationships and workforce records. Qualify the type; a party is not necessarily a customer or person.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A party representing a human; its party ID is distinct from login identity, workforce-profile ID and recruitment-application ID.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The commercial account identified by AccountPartyId, with a separate CRM account profile. It is not an authentication account.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: Commercial relationship-stage and note fields for an account party; its own Id is not AccountPartyId.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A typed link from an account to another party, optionally associated with project links.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A typed directed source-party/target-party relationship with its own identity and optional dates.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A business role attached to a party, with its own title, primary flag and optional validity interval.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A typed contact value attached to a party, with a label and primary/public flags. It is not itself a person identity.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A contact created through the inspected PublicContacts input; the mapper marks it IsPublic=true. Do not infer internet-public authorization from this data flag.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A party marked for restricted handling by its owner. Visibility and redaction still depend on the actual read endpoint and current authority.
not_synonyms: all its data is absent in every response
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A separate restricted CRM/HR note record, not Party.Notes or Party.Summary. The inspected party-create API does not accept this collection.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A prospective commercial engagement associated with an account, owner, stage, optional value and project link.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The commercial lifecycle position of an opportunity; not the account relationship stage or party lifecycle status.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The opportunity's ProbabilityPercent value; it describes commercial likelihood, not execution progress. Validate its allowed range at the owner before adding constraints.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The monetary value retained on an opportunity-stage history record for recognition, distinct from its current editable opportunity amount.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A workforce-specific record linked to a party, with work classification, capacity, rates and managerial fields. Profile Id and PartyId have different meanings.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The workforce cost amount expressed per RateUnit and in RateCurrencyCode, not a total task estimate.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The workforce billing amount per the declared rate unit and currency, distinct from internal cost.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A dated capacity restriction/reservation fact for a party, with a block kind, percentage and optional project reference. It is not itself a task assignment.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A request for a role/skills and allocation over an interval, optionally bound to a project and its lifetime.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A catalog definition of a workforce skill. This is not an executable agent skill package.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A party's recorded proficiency/experience in a referenced workforce skill definition.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A candidate party's application for a role, with its own identity, stage and decision. Qualify application to avoid confusion with the software product.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: An interview belonging to a recruitment application, with scheduling, interviewer and outcome fields.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: An onboarding/offboarding task associated with a party and optionally a project. Not a canonical Project Structure task.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A CRM communication/activity record with subject, summary and optional next-action/related opportunity or project information.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A follow-up associated with a CRM interaction, optionally assigned and due-dated; not an implicit canonical task.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: An Agents-owned executable agent configuration and identity. CRM exposes a projection/binding rather than another authoritative technical definition.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A declared/assigned capability that participates in runtime eligibility checks. A catalog entry alone does not make a tool executable.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: An executable function attached to an eligible invocation through the runtime provider/composition policy.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: One invocation of a runtime function, with arguments and an outcome. Distinguish a call, its retry attempt and the business target.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A governed agent execution instance, not the entire chat session and not a workflow/process run.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: An owner-managed provider configuration selected by a ProviderProfileId. Distinguish it from a provider kind, model name and shared publication.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The model-selection value used within a specific provider/transport contract. It is not the provider profile identifier.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A published provider capability identified by its publication identity/revision; not the caller's local provider profile.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The routing value accepted by the shared-provider relay as model; do not substitute a private upstream configuration ID.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A reusable ordinary LLM chat configuration with revisions, provider/model settings and optional response format. It is not a governed agent.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A conversation referring to a definition and definition revision, with transcript revision and optional active operation.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The conversational unit identified by TurnId; messages/entries and active operation IDs are separate identities.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: One recorded conversation message with role, content and its own EntryId, associated with a turn.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The revision of conversation history used in relevant read/edit preconditions, distinct from definition revision and conversation concurrency token.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: Provider-reported input, output and cached-input usage quantities, not a monetary cost or authorization token.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The reusable workflow configuration; distinguish the definition/catalog identity from a particular workflow execution.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A particular workflow execution, with its own status, external responses and recovery/observation contract.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A particular process orchestration execution; it can contain steps and agent/workflow work without sharing their identifiers.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: An authoritative owner-observed write/effect. A transport success, a generated answer or a completed read is not by itself proof of commitment.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A rejection whose owner proves that the relevant effect did not occur. Do not use it for arbitrary failures after dispatch.
terms.documentation_rule: Do not treat None and NotCommitted enum values as interchangeable; describe their actual owner-specific contract.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: An outcome for which the system cannot prove whether the effect committed. Reconciliation, not blind repetition, is required.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: Owner-backed determination/recovery of an uncertain or partially delivered operation using retained identity/evidence; it is not a new business mutation by default.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: Permission to expose a previously saved tool result under current authority. It is distinct from permission to execute another mutation.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: Owner-produced evidence identifying a committed effect or coordinated operation. State the exact receipt type and its guarantees.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: Content addressed through a storage provider/catalog and locator contract. Do not describe it as an arbitrary filesystem path.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A storage-provider-specific reference to content; its accepted syntax and visibility are contract-specific.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The actual stored content returned by a content endpoint/stream, distinct from metadata, filename or a placement record.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The association/delivery of content into an owner-managed location, potentially with separate recovery and continuation evidence.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The schema governing a requested model response format. It is not the OpenAPI schema of the surrounding HTTP DTO.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A member serialized as JSON data, with its own allowed shape; it is not necessarily a string containing serialized JSON.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: A request-body limit measured in encoded bytes, distinct from character counts. Verify the limit for each endpoint.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required

terms.definition: The text-length unit explicitly used by the inspected shared-provider relay subset; it is not a global API length convention.
terms.wording_status: proposed canonical English terminology; adoption required
